run.purpose: Record the three items the citation-network checker leaves for human review on the AJR 2001 run, each with its challenge state, and any challenge decided by a person or a separately run reviewer. As of this context no challenge has been made.
run.recorded_by: Context written by Claude (Anthropic) in a Claude Code session, 4 November 2026, at the repository owner's request. Records built by the deterministic program atlas.challenge.

code_author.basis: Wrote atlas.challenge and this context. A challenger declaring this identity, or declaring atlas_code_author YES, is rejected. Identity strings are declared, so this is a guard against honest error, not proof.
